tests.name: App: responds to simple request
tests.setup: sed -i "/gem 'ZenTest'/d" Gemfile && bundle install && bundle install --gemfile=.github/classroom/Gemfile && RAILS_ENV=development bundle exec rake db:setup && bundle exec rails server -e development -p 3000 -d && for i in {1..60}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/movies >/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done
tests.run: HEROKU_URI=127.0.0.1:3000 bundle exec --gemfile=.github/classroom/Gemfile rspec .github/classroom/app_spec.rb -e "responds to simple request"
